BiblicalUsage: Jedidah was the mother of Josiah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath. Her son was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mother of a reforming king matters, and Jedidah's name is kept because her son turned the nation back to God.
